column1: Fahkumram is a character with clear strengths and weaknesses. He has an unique design that requires a unique concept in terms of movement and mix-ups. You will need to learn how to side STEP ( not side WALK) with this character.
He mainly takes advantage of the enormous range he has, and not being predictable with his 50/50 mix-ups
